hypothesis.route: Use the existing optimized CUDA MMVQ rows kernel against the direct resident hot-source pool as a compare-only diagnostic.
hypothesis.why_new: The closed exact Q8_0 probes preserve CPU-compatible MXFP4 x Q8_0 arithmetic but are too slow. The vendor CUDA MMVQ path is already optimized for MXFP4 x F32/Q8_1 activations and is used by the accepted gate stream path. It may expose whether the remaining gap is exact-arithmetic overhead rather than source residency alone.
hypothesis.risk: MMVQ is not expected to be bit-exact with the CPU Q8_0 fallback. This probe must not write logits or clear fallback counts. If performance is promising, a separate write/skip top1 gate is required before any strict cold benchmark.

implementation_plan.cpu_callsite: Extend the existing hot-batch probe call to pass F32 src1 data and strides in addition to the current Q8_0 fallback buffer.
implementation_plan.cuda_probe: Add GGML_MOE_STREAM_MMVQ_HOT_BATCH_PROBE=1 inside the existing compare path. Gather ready rows by expert from the direct pool, copy their F32 activations to device, call ggml_cuda_moe_stream_mmvq_rows_dev in chunks of <= MMVQ_MAX_BATCH_SIZE, copy outputs back, and compare against CPU dst.
implementation_plan.default_behavior: No change unless GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_HOT_BATCH_PROBE_OUT, GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_HOT_BATCH_PROBE_COMPARE=1, and GGML_MOE_STREAM_MMVQ_HOT_BATCH_PROBE=1 are all set.

pass_fail_gates.build: cmake --build build-ds4-moe-stream --target llama-cli llama-results -j 8 must pass
pass_fail_gates.compare_only_correctness: Probe must not change logits; fixed-text top1 report must still pass because CPU fallback output remains authoritative.
pass_fail_gates.error_report: Record op-level max_abs/mean_abs/diff_count versus CPU fallback. If error is nonzero, do not promote without a later write/skip top1 gate.
pass_fail_gates.memory: 16GB cgroup including page cache, MemorySwapMax=0, no OOM and no swap
pass_fail_gates.performance_reopen: Projected top128 MMVQ kernel+integration must be <= 179.257 ms before any write/skip token-stability experiment is allowed
